title: Array representation across disjoint writes
summary: Constructs represented UInt64-array prefixes and preserves complete arrays across disjoint writes or memory growth without re-proving length and element reads.

tactics.goalShape: A read64 equation over one or more nested write64 updates at equal or arithmetically disjoint addresses.
premises: Address equality or eight-byte disjointness provable by arithmetic
For preservation: a represented array, nondecreasing pages, and unchanged bytes on its complete interval
For frameBefore: unchanged pages and bytes below a cutoff above the array
For prefix construction: address and memory bounds, the stored final length, and each next in-bounds value
For WritesRange: disjoint source and changed byte intervals
result: The input representation remains valid across framed writes, or consecutive element writes establish the complete output representation.
